title: A drive to Mexico City to hear local jazz
summary: Audre recalls Mexico City and a trumpeter named Chocolate, whom they disagree on identifying.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: In fact, I remember I was working one day, and you said, “Let’s go to Mexico,” and I quit my job immediately and we drove down. That was before Alissa was born. We drove down that old highway to Mexico City.

In Mexico City you kept asking everybody... You were trying to be understood that you wanted to hear the Mexican version of American jazz, what was equivalent to jazz, and they would send us to clubs where they had American jazz. And then we found Chocolate...
No, honey. Chocolate. I remember him. With a whole bunch of...all different rhythm instruments. It was wonderful.
Might it have been Perez Prado’s band. He was based in Mexico City?
But it was really exciting and it was really good music. I really enjoyed it.
